basic_info.description: Experience the absolute best of Hayes Valley in this stunning 2BR/2BA corner unit with iconic views of City Hall! Boasting floor-to-ceiling windows throughout the home, this sunny residence offers a spacious, open floor plan that seamlessly connects the kitchen, dining and living areas. The gourmet kitchen is perfect for entertaining and is equipped with premium Bosch appliances, spacious quartz island, and customized cabinetry. The generously sized bedrooms feature ample storage and customized closets, while the luxurious bathrooms offer deep soaking tubs. Additional features include in-unit laundry and 1 garage parking space. Building amenities include rooftop deck with BBQ, front desk concierge, dog run, lounge, conference rooms, bike room, and direct access to Trader Joe's downstairs within the building. Living in Hayes Valley means you have access to a rich cultural scene, with Hayes Valley Corridor showcasing renowned restaurants like Chez Maman and Rich Table. Entertainment scene is lively with SF Jazz, SF Symphony, and SF Ballet/Opera just steps away. Public parks like Patricia's Green Park and Alamo Square Park provide a peaceful getaway from the bustling city. With a Walk Score of 99, everything you need is within reach, including MUNI, BART, and 101/280HWY!
